key: Add additional tanks as needed (stock tank 1 always stays). Do not switch senders onto the PCM FLI pin (false fill). source: Add additional tanks as needed (stock tank 1 always stays). Do not switch senders onto the PCM FLI pin (false fill). Each extra tank needs its own Torque extra PID (MCU Mode 22, unique name — not 012F or Ford 16C1). Select-PID value is the 1-based tank id. Gal/hr is charged only to the active tank.

Her tanka zêde PID-eke zêde ya Torque ya xwe dixwaze (MCU Mode 22, navê yekta — ne 012F an Ford 16C1). Nirxa Select-PID id ya tankê ye ku ji 1 dest pê dike. Gal/hr tenê li tanka çalak tê barkirin.

key:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
source:
Quick start
 1. Install Torque Pro (the paid version; Torque Lite does not support plugins) and pair your OBD-II adapter.
 2. Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.
 3. Allow notifications, and set battery use to Unrestricted so Torque can start this plugin in the background.
 4. In Torque, select the vehicle profile for the car you are driving. Data is kept per Torque profile and checked against the vehicle's VIN/ECU identity.
 5. On a new profile the fuel source is detected when you connect; if asked, compare it with your dash gauge and tap Confirm. Confirm is on the setup page and in the notification. You can also pick it below.
 6. There is no tank size to enter here. Each fit learns its own size, shown under Learned tank size; until then its corrected percent reads 1:1 with the gauge. Enter your tank size in the Torque vehicle profile for Torque's own remaining fuel and DTE.
 7. In Torque, add gauges for [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level and each fit's Corrected % and Tank size. The plugin does not publish remaining fuel or DTE. A notice during a refit says that fit reads 1:1 until its refit finishes.
 8. Feed fuel level back to Torque: Off, Smoothed, or Corrected from the Chunk, Band or Kalman fit onto your 012F gauge. Torque's own fuel remaining and DTE then use that level with the tank size and long-term mpg in the Torque profile.
 9. Fuel is counted only while the engine runs. The plugin runs only while Torque is connected to the ECU.
 10. Keep driving and filling up; accuracy builds over several partial tanks. If the plugin cannot tell which vehicle this is, it asks in a notification and on this page; choose what to do with that drive.
 11. All data stays on this phone. No GPS or location is recorded.
text:
Destpêka bilez
1. Torque Pro saz bike (guhertoya bi pere; Torque Lite pêvekan piştgirî nake) û adaptera xwe ya OBD-II cot bike.
2. Vê pêvekê di Torque → Mîheng → Pêvek de veke.
3. Agahdariyan bihêle, û bikaranîna bateriyê bike Bê sînor da ku Torque karibe vê pêvekê di paşperdeyê de bide destpêkirin.
4. Di Torque de, profîla wesayîtê ya otomobîla ku tu diajotî hilbijêre. Dane li gorî her profîla Torque têne hilanîn û bi nasnameya VIN/ECU ya wesayîtê re tên berawirdkirin.
5. Li profîleke nû, çavkaniya sotemeniyê dema ku tu girê didî tê tesbîtkirin; heke bê pirsîn, bi pîvana panelê re bide ber hev û Piştrast bike bitikîne. Piştrast bike li rûpela sazkirinê û di agahdariyê de ye. Tu dikarî li jêr jî hilbijêrî.
6. Li vir mezinahiya tankê ya ku were nivîsandin tune ye. Her lihevhatin mezinahiya xwe hîn dibe, di bin Mezinahiya tankê ya hînkirî de tê nîşandan; heta wê demê ji sedî ya rastkirî bi pîvanê re 1:1 dixwîne. Mezinahiya tankê têxe profîla wesayîtê ya Torque ji bo sotemeniya mayî û DTE ya Torque bi xwe.
7. Di Torque de, pîvanan ji bo [FuelSmooth] Smoothed Fuel Level û, ji bo her lihevhatinê, Corrected % û Tank size zêde bike. Pêvek sotemeniya mayî an DTE belav nake. Agahdariyek di dema ji nû ve lihevkirinê de dibêje ku ew lihevhatin 1:1 dixwîne heta ji nû ve lihevhatin biqede.
8. Asta sotemeniyê vegerîne Torque: Girtî, Nermkirî, an Rastkirî ji lihevhatina Chunk, Band an Kalman li ser pîvana te ya 012F. Paşê sotemeniya mayî û DTE ya Torque bi xwe wê astê bi mezinahiya tankê û mpg ya demdirêj a profîla Torque bikar tîne.
9. Sotemenî tenê dema motor dixebite tê hejmartin. Pêvek tenê dema Torque bi ECU ve girêdayî ye dixebite.
10. Ajotin û dagirtinê bidomîne; rastbûn di çend tankên qismî de zêde dibe. Heke pêvek nikaribe bêje ev kîjan wesayît e, di agahdariyê û li ser vê rûpelê de dipirse; hilbijêre ku bi wê rêwîtiyê çi bikî.
11. Hemû dane li ser vî telefonî dimînin. GPS an cih nayê tomarkirin.
